label: Nasu no Brown Cheese
aka: 那須のブラウンチーズ

about.text: A brown whey cheese from Nasu no Mori in Tochigi, made from the whey left over from cheesemaking. The whey is boiled down and stirred while heated, giving a smooth, sweet-tart, brown cheese that is not aged.

sources.text: Its whey-boiling method and its awards, from this page.
